scope.implemented: bounded revision-matched authoritative fleet contact-geometry catalogue and read-only native body-frame wireframe inspector
scope.not_implemented: beauty meshes, model/asset identity, split render ownership, world fleet draws, common render epoch, prediction/reconciliation or complete resource replication
scope.protocol: v8; FleetSnapshot gains geometry_revision and kind 10 carries FleetGeometry; v7 is rejected
scope.licensing: GPL game wire/UI policy; existing MIT CollisionGeometry and generic protocol envelope contracts reused without moving GPL game logic into engine crates

contracts.identity: stable VehicleId plus bounded display name only; names are not asset keys or design hashes; no file path/URL/load command or bulk GLB on the wire
contracts.geometry: actual authoritative CollisionGeometry, including per-part body-local position/orientation, physical dimensions and collision material; split definitions use their recentered cluster frame
contracts.budget: 128 UTF-8 bytes per display label with producer-side control-character filtering; 64 contact parts per secondary, 63 secondaries; empty source is Absent and over-budget source is explicit OmittedBudget, never a partial hull; no change to authoritative physics
contracts.validation: post-decode catalogue/ID/count/label/shape/pose/material checks; existing 8 MiB frame limit; not a proof of bounded transient decoder allocation or complete hostile-server validation
contracts.publication: one cached catalogue/frame on server; compare authoritative definitions by borrowing, build/encode only on descriptor change; per-mailbox revision marker suppresses retransmission after drain; new subscriber gets the current catalogue
contracts.transport: same single reader, bounded inbox with Arc payloads; on-change catalogue waits for the short queue lock rather than being silently lost under contention; no lock during pipe IO; PRIMARY interpolation unchanged
contracts.pairing: only identical revision and complete member IDs attach geometry to poses; either delivery order supported; mismatched in-flight revisions show waiting; backwards/reused/corrupt revisions fail through existing native freeze/no-fallback path
contracts.immutability: correctly referenced unchanged catalogue does not need repeated receive-age refresh; stale fleet observations still hide all rows; geometry is Arc-shared through HUD stats, not deep-copied per frame
contracts.preview: diagnostic auto-fit isometric body-frame wireframe; first row open when available, other rows collapsible; f64 normalization before f32 UI coordinates; unrepresentable scale is reported; no projection/UI work with --no-hud
contracts.preview_error: cuboid edges exact; sphere great circles have 16 chords, sagitta <1.93% radius; capsule semicircles have 16 chords, sagitta <0.49% radius; regression pins subdivision count and envelopes; no physical-law reduction

reproduction.physical_replay_peer: Python stdio peer reads u32-LE Hello length and discards that Hello payload, writes .frame once then .samples every 0.05 s; no authority stepping or input acknowledgement; scratch script apps/server/target/test-tmp/fleet-separation-peer.py
reproduction.physical_replay_peer_source:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import pathlib, struct, sys, time
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
length = sys.stdin.buffer.read(4)
if len(length) != 4: raise SystemExit(1)
sys.stdin.buffer.read(struct.unpack('<I', length)[0])
sys.stdout.buffer.write((root / 'fleet-separation-v8.frame').read_bytes())
sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
sample = (root / 'fleet-separation-v8.samples').read_bytes()
while True:
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(sample)
    sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
    time.sleep(0.05)
reproduction.physical_replay_peer_setup: After generation, write physical_replay_peer_source verbatim to apps/server/target/test-tmp/fleet-separation-peer.py and chmod +x that file. The whole scratch directory is ignored; no captured frame is a production asset.

limitations: Contact geometry is not appearance: authored external meshes, model keys, surface materials and split render ownership still need a separate contract. The native PRIMARY remains the compatibility X-15 renderer even in custom-authority diagnostic replays.
The frozen real-server separation replay proves geometric provenance/COM partition/transport/inspector, not a live server command acknowledgement or a whole-scene flight/render acceptance test.
The capacity screenshot uses synthetic PRIMARY placement near terrain (AGL zero), inherited occlusion/LOD defects and 63 explicitly fixture-derived observations, not 63 physically separated vehicles.
Omitted geometry descriptors do not track changes hidden behind the same budget omission; labels are bounded display data, not full design identity.
Independently coalesced PRIMARY/fleet/catalogue slots are not a paired common-time scene. No remote interpolation or extrapolation is added.
Old Bevy host ignores fleet observations; it must be rebuilt for v8. Its audio remains unverified due to device warnings.

Captures are implementer diagnostics, not blind preference review, matched native/Bevy scenes, visual parity or complete Bevy displacement. Existing terrain/material/sky/effect/UI/platform gaps remain.
